name: Blue Lock Incremental [V6]
desc:
Step into the world of Blue Lock and forge your path to becoming the world's greatest striker.
Roll for legendary Weapons, Playstyles, Egos, and Talents — each with rarities ranging from Common all the way to the ultra-rare Immortal tier. Train your Offense and Defense stats, earn Yen and Fans, climb through story arcs, and power up through Rebirths to grow stronger than ever.
⚽ Features:

🎲 Roll & collect unique abilities across 6 rarities
🏋️ Train your stats and level up through the Blue Lock arcs
💀 Defeat bosses and rise through the ranks
🔄 Rebirth to reset and multiply your power
🏆 Compete on the leaderboard and show off your build
🎁 Redeem codes for free rolls!

Only the ego of the best will survive Blue Lock.
